structural_change: ConvNeXt V1-Tiny + sex embedding + shared fusion + separate Male/Female 240-bin LDL heads
key_observation: Strong and stable single-model baseline; used as the reference architecture for later ablations.

structural_change: Added zero-initialized sex-conditioned FiLM blocks to ConvNeXt stages 1-4 while preserving the sex-specific LDL heads
key_observation: Early sex conditioning was learned but overall generalization degraded.

structural_change: Added 1D CDF/Wasserstein-1 ordinal loss to the core LDL objective
key_observation: CDF objective continued to decrease after validation MAE stopped improving, indicating an objective trade-off.

structural_change: Reduced the CDF/Wasserstein regularization weight from 0.02 to 0.005
key_observation: Weak ordinal regularization produced a small but consistent improvement over the core model.

structural_change: Added Stage-3 learned spatial attention with a continuous young-to-wrist / older-to-finger pairwise centroid prior
key_observation: The spatial ordering signal was learned easily, but the gain in bone-age prediction was small.

structural_change: Combined weak CDF regularization with the continuous spatial attention prior
key_observation: RMSE improved slightly, but the attention gain was not additive in MAE.

structural_change: Trained a local-only expert using an automatically generated upper-hand ROI discovered from CAM/localization analysis
key_observation: Local-only accuracy was weaker than whole-hand input, but the upper ROI provided complementary error signals on hard cases.

structural_change: Frozen whole-hand and upper-ROI experts; concatenated shared features and learned a zero-initialized residual sex-specific LDL correction head
key_observation: Best single-model validation MAE among the structural fusion experiments, but the improvement was small relative to added inference complexity.

structural_change: Combined whole-hand, middle-ROI and upper-ROI features using relation features, a sample-wise sigmoid gate and residual logits
key_observation: The learned gate collapsed to an almost constant value and failed to improve the core model.

structural_change: Averaged predictions from the core LDL model and a complementary multi-window model
key_observation: Good RMSE and validation MAE, but required two complete inference models.

structural_change: Warm-started from the core model and regularized local signed-error bias across continuous sex-by-age Gaussian windows
key_observation: Reduced local bias modestly but produced only a very small aggregate validation gain.

structural_change: Froze the shared representation and Female head; fine-tuned only the Male LDL head with young-male bias penalty and older-male teacher consistency
key_observation: Reduced Male <=60-month MAE to 5.880 and bias to +3.528 months while preserving the Female branch.

structural_change: Increased the model input resolution from 512x512 to 768x512 while keeping the core modeling direction
key_observation: Higher input resolution did not improve validation performance.
